formulas.name: Topology Axioms
formulas.conditions: Union closure is arbitrary; intersection closure is finite only.
formulas.whenToUse: Verifying whether a given collection is a topology.
formulas.commonMistake: Assuming intersection closure holds for infinite collections too.

formulas.name: Closure Formula
formulas.symbols: A': the derived set (all limit points of A).
formulas.conditions: \bar A is the smallest closed set containing A.
formulas.whenToUse: Computing the closure of a set, or testing density (\bar A = X).
formulas.commonMistake: Assuming every point of A is automatically a limit point of A (false for isolated points).
